implemented_contracts: CompilationRequest exposes all eight caller-injected Session dependencies
Deadline is separated from semantic CompilationOptions and shares the injected MonotonicClock domain
DocumentSourceProvider and FrontendRegistry are replaceable instance seams without global state
PublicationRequest and ContextPublisher use Optional EngineContext expectations
PublicationResult interface is separated from PublicationStatus
CompilationResult is an interface exposing only status and diagnostics
PublishedCompilationResult exposes the complete frozen published fact
Published result requires exact model identity and reuses model diagnostics
Failed result exposes no candidate model, context, digest or versions
value object string representations contain all semantic fields
